Your AI in the Sky

AI-driven Intelligence

for the World’s Most Dangerous Jobs

We’ve designed our rugged, easy-to-operate system to make it as simple as possible to deploy & run your own fleet of nimble, AI-driven drones. Their ability to detect threats and provide real-time intelligence allows you to focus on the most important job on the planet: the protection of life. 

AI-driven Intelligence that IDs threats in real-time

Using machine vision and AI, Data Blanket puts full situational awareness, insights and detection at your fingertips. Our easy to operate system provides instantaneous 24/7 intelligence based on multi-view detection and identification of threats.
